Full desktop control

You can fully control your desktop with Gesleap, including the clicks, scrolling, drag n' drop, transmit keystrokes, or close/minimize windows.

Shooter game

Simple augmented reality shooter game, which uses the depth information of the hand to eject bullets.

Create your own gesture interfaces

With the SDK, the engine can be tailored to create UIs to control not only games, but general applications such as 3D model viewers.

Version 0.29 demo

Full gesture control. It allows you to use your hand as a mouse substitute, send keystrokes, or even launch custom commands — such as opening a browser. It even supports two-handed control.
